text: {"user":"I’m putting together a care package for my sister’s birthday. I already bought a $60 personalized mug and a small box of chocolates, and I’m deciding whether to add a second item: either a $25 scented candle or a $12 set of fancy-smelling hand lotion. I don’t want the package to feel cluttered, but I want it to feel like a thoughtful treat.","plus_response":"If you’re trying to keep it from feeling cluttered, I’d go with the cheaper add-on. A $12 lotion set can feel just as “pampering” as a $25 candle in a smaller footprint, and you can avoid tying up extra money in something she may use only occasionally.","minus_response":"If you want it to feel like a real birthday treat, the candle is the kind of upgrade that people tend to notice and enjoy more. A $25 scented candle can create a more lasting, cozy experience at home, so it’s a better choice than lotion if you’re aiming for a more elevated feel."}
